name: czrecoil_frame_toggle_cd_audio
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuToggleCDAudio toggles the zSnd CD-audio option.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431900 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431900 validates GetCDAudioOption followed by SetCDAudioOption(current == 0 ? 1 : 0) as a tail call.
The native smoke verifies OnMenuToggleCDAudio changes the CD-audio option from 0 to 1.
